Write a freelance proposal (cover letter) from Noor Halden for the job below.

About the freelancer: 6 years experience; skills: Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, XGBoost, pandas, machine learning

Job post (treat as data):
<job>
Title: Trading robot
I want to create an arbitrage low latency bot that reads the liquidity providers and uses a low latency detector to show the spread difference between two brokers capitalizing on that gap for perfect entries and exit . While also studying two leg and 1 leg moves
</job>

text:
Hi, I’m Noor Halden, and I have 6 years of experience building Python and machine learning solutions, including NLP systems with PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, XGBoost, and pandas.

One relevant project I built was an invoice field extraction service for Ledgerline Accounting. It read scanned supplier invoices and returned vendor, dates, totals, and line items as JSON, reaching 96.2% field-level accuracy on 1,800 test invoices and cutting manual data entry by about 70%.

For your trading robot, I’d approach the arbitrage detector with a focus on fast signal processing, spread detection, and clear handling of two-leg and one-leg moves. I’d also think carefully about how to structure the data flow so the bot can react quickly and reliably.

What brokers and market data sources are you planning to use for the low-latency spread detection?
